description: This file defines the interface class IServerManagerService for the RialtoServerManager, including its methods for application management, session state changes, connection info retrieval, logging level setting, and log handler registration.

classes.name: IServerManagerService
classes.description: Interface class providing API for RialtoServerManager, including methods for application lifecycle management, session state control, connection info, logging, and log handler registration.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Starts an application with a specified session server state and configuration.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Requests a session server to change its state for a given application.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the socket name used for communication with a specific application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for all Rialto applications.

methods.name: registerLogHandler
methods.description: Registers a new log handler for the Rialto server manager to receive log messages.
